channel.title: KPFK - Working Voices
channel.description: Working Voices focuses on the issues and concerns of working people and the labor movement including living wages, occupational health and safety, economic inequality, ending race and gender discrimination,wage theft, and also solidarity, unity and organizing the unorganized.
